# Juhi Chavda: AEO, SEO, websites & custom ERP

> Juhi Chavda is an Ahmedabad-based marketer who helps startups, MSMEs and founders worldwide get found on Google and named in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), and builds the websites, custom tools and ERP systems behind that growth.

Services: AEO (answer engine optimisation), SEO, GEO, international and local SEO, website design and development, brand design, custom tools and AI automation, custom ERP for MSMEs, CRM and WhatsApp automation, performance ads, guerrilla marketing and personal branding. Free AI visibility audits are available via the contact form.

## Main

- [Home](https://juhichavda.com/): services, process, pricing models, FAQ and contact
- [All free tools](https://juhichavda.com/tools/): list of free calculators and generators

## Tools

- [Free AI Visibility Checker: Will ChatGPT Recommend You? (2026)](https://juhichavda.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker/): Free AI visibility checker. See if ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews are likely to recommend your business, with a fix-list and test prompts.
- [ChatGPT Ads Cost Calculator (India ₹ & USD): Budget, CPM, CPC](https://juhichavda.com/tools/chatgpt-ads-cost-calculator/): Free ChatGPT Ads cost calculator. Plan spend, impressions, clicks, cost per lead and ROAS in ₹ or $, with India's ₹725/day minimum built in.
- [Instagram Engagement Rate Calculator (Free): by Followers or Reach](https://juhichavda.com/tools/instagram-engagement-rate-calculator/): Free Instagram engagement rate calculator. Calculate engagement by followers or by reach using likes, comments, saves and shares, for one post or an average.
- [Free llms.txt Generator: Create Your llms.txt File (2026)](https://juhichavda.com/tools/llms-txt-generator/): Free llms.txt generator. Create an llms.txt file for your website in seconds, then copy or download it. Includes what llms.txt does and where to upload it.
- [ROAS Calculator with Break-even ROAS (Free, 2026)](https://juhichavda.com/tools/roas-calculator/): Free ROAS calculator: work out return on ad spend, break-even ROAS, target ROAS and profit after ads for Google, Meta or ChatGPT ads.
- [Meta Description & Title Length Checker with Google Preview (2026)](https://juhichavda.com/tools/serp-snippet-checker/): Free title and meta description length checker with a live Google preview for desktop and mobile. See pixel width and whether your snippet gets cut off.

- [How to Get Your Business on ChatGPT (2026): SEO vs AEO + 9 Steps](https://juhichavda.com/guides/how-to-get-your-business-on-chatgpt/): How to get your business recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode in 2026. SEO vs AEO vs GEO explained, 9 practical steps, mistakes to avoid and FAQs.
- [Guides: AEO, SEO and ERP for Small Businesses (2026)](https://juhichavda.com/guides/): Plain-English guides for founders and MSMEs: getting your business on ChatGPT, AEO questions answered, and choosing between Tally and an ERP.
